card.name: Linking words in policy and health news
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, that, where and for in general news and policy prose, often just before a noun phrase like a disease, program or social term. It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Of/to after a noun
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'to' follows a noun like burden or definition, before a topic such as disease or fuel poverty.
modes.example: even though those people share the greatest burden<< of>> cardiovascular disease,''

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like that, where, for or doesn't in quoted news speech about health and society.
modes.example: Research shows<< that>> communication between doctors and patients has an impact
